context: Full verification of a memo with nine load-bearing claims: five rest on one protocol's filings, three on one analytics vendor's data, and one on a court record
passes_if: It forms three claim clusters by shared source set, seats one verifier per cluster, and each verifier runs every kill test on every claim it holds
fails_if: It seats one verifier per claim or one for all nine, or a verifier skips kill tests on part of its cluster

phrases: A claim cluster is the claims that rest on the same source set
